description: A Combine sink captures self strongly and is stored on self.cancellables, forming a retain cycle. Must be flagged. No style/lint nits.

should_flag.hint: The sink closure captures `self` strongly and the AnyCancellable is stored on self.cancellables -> reference cycle; SmokeTestController never deallocates. Fix: [weak self].

should_not_flag.hint: Do not raise SwiftLint-style nits (formatting, naming, line length, modifier order) — those are deferred to SwiftLint.
